name: Mastersystem Infotama Tbk.
summary: PT Mastersystem Infotama Tbk offers comprehensive ICT infrastructure and system integration services to a diverse clientele within Indonesia, specifically targeting the enterprise banking, oil and gas, general corporate, and telecommunications sectors. Their specialized offerings encompass solutions for data center and cloud infrastructure, enterprise collaboration platforms, digital business management, big data and analytics, and robust security architecture. Additionally, the company delivers a broad spectrum of operational support, covering system monitoring and issue remediation, installations and configurations, proactive and reactive maintenance, performance and capacity oversight, secure data backup and recovery, strategic capacity planning, patch management, enterprise mobility solutions, hardware replacement assistance, and detailed maintenance reporting. Established in 1994, Mastersystem Infotama Tbk maintains its corporate headquarters in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia.
